_README: Copy to capability_policy.json to override the built-in tier table in
capability_policy.py. Keys are action_type names as passed to
amber — mutates data, apps or external services. Needs approval
red   — destructive / code-exec / self-modify / send / spend.
Never allowed autonomously, approved or not.
Overrides only RAISE or LOWER the starting tier. The live escalation
layers still run on top: confirm_gate can push a tier to AMBER and
decision_engine.safety_check can push it to RED, and the strictest
verdict wins. An unknown action the safety whitelist does not
recognise resolves to RED, and if an escalation layer cannot answer at
all the action is denied — the gate fails closed, never open.
So lowering something to 'green' here is a request, not a guarantee.
This file is optional; with it absent the built-in table is used.
Unparseable values are skipped rather than crashing the engine.
